questions.prompt: If I ___ more money, I would buy a bigger house.
questions.explanation: Second conditional: if + past simple, would + base verb.

wrongReasons.0: The present simple belongs to the first conditional (will).
wrongReasons.2: Do not use 'would' in the if-clause.
wrongReasons.3: Do not use 'will' in the if-clause.

questions.prompt: She said that she ___ the report the day before.
questions.explanation: In reported speech the past simple often changes to the past perfect: she had finished.

wrongReasons.0: 'the day before' shows that the action was earlier than the reporting.
wrongReasons.2: 'has finished' is present perfect and does not fit after 'said'.
wrongReasons.3: 'finishes' is the present simple and does not fit after 'said'.
